change.en: Keelson at commit 6e62a9e, before the case study changed anything.
change.zh: 提交 6e62a9e 时的 Keelson，实战案例还没有改动任何东西。

label.en: After the loop-guard and empty-reply fixes
label.zh: 修复循环保护与空回复之后

change.en: An empty model reply is retried instead of ending the turn. The loop guard survives a context fold, counts shell commands by program instead of as one tool, and ends the turn itself after three trips.
change.zh: 模型返回空回复时重试，而不是当作任务结束。循环保护不再被上下文折叠清零；shell 命令按程序而不是按“一个工具”计数；触发三次后由运行时强制收尾。

change.en: On Windows a command of several lines now runs every line (cmd.exe ran only the first and dropped the rest in silence), and a quoted string that spans lines is refused with the reason.
change.zh: 在 Windows 上，多行命令的每一行都会执行（此前 cmd.exe 只执行第一行，其余静默丢弃）；跨行的引号字符串会被明确拒绝并说明原因。

cases.title: bucket ignores a supplied validator when the callable is falsey

summary.en: `bucket()` picks its validator with `validator or default`, so a callable that happens to be falsey (an empty set subclass with `__call__`) is silently replaced by one that accepts every key.
summary.zh: `bucket()` 用 `validator or default` 选校验器，于是一个恰好为假值的可调用对象（比如带 `__call__` 的空集合子类）会被悄悄换成“全部放行”的默认实现。

cases.agent_diff:
diff --git a/more_itertools/more.py b/more_itertools/more.py
index 940b800..7b42428 100755
--- a/more_itertools/more.py
+++ b/more_itertools/more.py
@@ -1182,7 +1182,7 @@ class bucket:
         self._it = iter(iterable)
         self._key = key
         self._cache = defaultdict(deque)
-        self._validator = validator or (lambda x: True)
+        self._validator = (lambda x: True) if validator is None else validator
 
     def __contains__(self, value):
         if not self._validator(value):

diff --git a/more_itertools/more.py b/more_itertools/more.py

+++ b/more_itertools/more.py
@@ -1182,7 +1182,10 @@ class bucket:
         self._it = iter(iterable)
         self._key = key
         self._cache = defaultdict(deque)
-        self._validator = validator or (lambda x: True)
+        # Use ``is None`` rather than truthiness: a valid validator may be a
+        # callable object that is falsey (e.g. an empty ``set`` subclass with
+        # ``__call__``), and ``validator or ...`` would silently replace it.
+        self._validator = (lambda x: True) if validator is None else validator
 
     def __contains__(self, value):
         if not self._validator(value):

notes.en: No empty reply this time. Twenty-one calls went into finding the class and getting a repro to run (multi-line commands still ran only their first line; it found `python -c "exec('…')"` by trial and error), then the same one-line fix as upstream. 29 calls.
notes.zh: 这次没有出现空回复。前 21 次调用花在定位这个类和让复现脚本跑起来上（多行命令仍然只执行第一行；它是自己试出来 `python -c "exec('…')"` 这种写法的），然后给出了与上游相同的一行修复。共 29 次调用。

cases.title: Failed TTL expiration calculation leaves an unusable cache entry

summary.en: `TTLCache.__setitem__` stores the value before computing `timer() + ttl`. If that addition overflows, a half-inserted entry with no expiry is left behind and later membership checks raise `TypeError`.
summary.zh: `TTLCache.__setitem__` 先写入值，再计算 `timer() + ttl`。这个加法一旦溢出，缓存里会留下一个没有过期时间的“半成品”条目，之后的成员检查直接抛 `TypeError`。

cases.agent_diff:
diff --git a/src/cachetools/__init__.py b/src/cachetools/__init__.py
index ac02074..34f86cf 100644
--- a/src/cachetools/__init__.py
+++ b/src/cachetools/__init__.py
@@ -497,13 +497,14 @@ class TTLCache(_TimedCache):
         with self.timer as time:
             self.expire(time)
             cache_setitem(self, key, value)
+        expires = time + self.__ttl
         try:
             link = self.__getlink(key)
         except KeyError:
             self.__links[key] = link = TTLCache._Link(key)
         else:
             link.unlink()
-        link.expires = time + self.__ttl
+        link.expires = expires
         link.next = root = self.__root
         link.prev = prev = root.prev
         prev.next = root.prev = link

notes.en: The guard tripped once, on the seventh identical probe; the model complied, read the code and edited, and `pytest` was no longer blocked. But the fix is wrong: it computes the expiry after the value has been written, so the half-written entry is still left behind. The existing tests pass, the hidden test fails, and the model never re-ran its own repro. A model error that the runtime did not catch.
notes.zh: 循环保护在第 7 次相同的试探时触发了一次；模型照做了，去读代码并修改，`pytest` 也不再被拦。但这次修错了：它在值写入之后才计算过期时间，半成品条目仍然会留下。现有测试全过，隐藏测试失败，而模型没有再跑一遍自己的复现脚本。这是模型的错误，运行时没有拦住。

cases.title: dotenv get exits with code 1 for empty string values

summary.en: `dotenv get KEY` tests the stored value for truthiness, so a key that is present but empty (`KEY=`) exits with code 1 exactly like a missing key.
summary.zh: `dotenv get KEY` 用真值判断取到的值，所以一个存在但为空的键（`KEY=`）会和不存在的键一样以退出码 1 结束。

notes.en: Fixed at tool call 6, verified, done in 16 calls. It also added a test to `tests/test_cli.py` although the instructions said not to edit existing tests. Nothing was removed, and the grader replaces that file anyway.
notes.zh: 第 6 次工具调用就改好了，验证后收尾，共 16 次调用。它还往 `tests/test_cli.py` 里加了一个测试，尽管指令里写了不要改已有测试。没有删任何东西，而且判分时这个文件会被上游版本覆盖。

cases.title: Decimal filesize YB to ZB rollover doesn't happen where expected

summary.en: `naturalsize()` chooses the unit from the unrounded byte count and rounds afterwards, so values just under a boundary print as `1000.0 ZB` instead of rolling over to `1.0 YB`.
summary.zh: `naturalsize()` 先按未舍入的字节数选单位，再做舍入，于是恰好在边界下方的值会显示成 `1000.0 ZB`，而不是进位成 `1.0 YB`。

cases.upstream_diff:
diff --git a/src/humanize/filesize.py b/src/humanize/filesize.py
index c495fed..315261a 100644
--- a/src/humanize/filesize.py
+++ b/src/humanize/filesize.py
@@ -97,6 +97,12 @@ def naturalsize(
         return f"{int(bytes_)}B" if gnu else _("%d Bytes") % int(bytes_)
 
     exp = int(min(log(abs_bytes, base), len(suffix)))
+    # The suffix is chosen from the unrounded byte count, but `format` rounds the
+    # mantissa afterward; rounding can push it up to `base` (e.g. 999999 is
+    # 999.999 kB, which formats to "1000.0 kB"). When that happens and a larger
+    # suffix is available, step up one suffix so the result reads "1.0 MB".
+    if exp < len(suffix) and abs(float(format % (abs_bytes / (base**exp)))) >= base:
+        exp += 1
     space = "" if gnu else " "
     ret: str = format % (bytes_ / (base**exp)) + space + _(suffix[exp - 1])
     return ret

notes.en: The same as round 1: 26 probes, no edit, the loop guard silent, 30-step limit.
notes.zh: 和第 1 轮一样：26 次试探，没有修改，循环保护没有触发，撞上 30 步上限。

cases.title: retry_if_exception_cause_type spins forever when the exception cause chain contains a cycle (e.g. `raise e from e`)

summary.en: `retry_if_exception_cause_type` walks `__cause__` until it reaches `None`. A cyclic chain (`raise e from e`) never ends, so the predicate spins at 100% CPU and the stop condition is never consulted.
summary.zh: `retry_if_exception_cause_type` 沿 `__cause__` 一直走到 `None`。遇到成环的异常链（`raise e from e`）就永远走不完：判断函数空转占满 CPU，停止条件根本没机会执行。

cases.agent_diff:
diff --git a/tenacity/retry.py b/tenacity/retry.py
index e59f4c0..d69c647 100644
--- a/tenacity/retry.py
+++ b/tenacity/retry.py
@@ -177,7 +177,11 @@ class retry_if_exception_cause_type(retry_base):
 
         if retry_state.outcome.failed:
             exc = retry_state.outcome.exception()
+            seen_exceptions: set[int] = set()
             while exc is not None:
+                if id(exc) in seen_exceptions:
+                    break
+                seen_exceptions.add(id(exc))
                 if isinstance(exc.__cause__, self.exception_cause_types):
                     return True
                 exc = exc.__cause__

--- a/tenacity/retry.py

@@ -161,7 +161,7 @@ class retry_if_exception_cause_type(retry_base):
     """Retries if any of the causes of the raised exception is of one or more types.
 
     The check on the type of the cause of the exception is done recursively (until finding
-    an exception in the chain that has no `__cause__`)
+    an exception in the chain that has no ``__cause__``, or a cycle is detected).
     """
 
     def __init__(
@@ -177,7 +177,12 @@ class retry_if_exception_cause_type(retry_base):
 
         if retry_state.outcome.failed:
             exc = retry_state.outcome.exception()
-            while exc is not None:
+            # Guard against cyclic __cause__ chains (e.g. ``raise e from e``),
+            # which would otherwise spin forever inside the predicate and
+            # prevent stop conditions from ever running (see #658).

notes.en: `write_file` for a new test was denied twice, so the model created the file with `echo … > file` in the shell, which the gate does not see as creating a file — and of that multi-line command only the first line ran. `del` was denied; it deleted with `python -c "os.remove(…)"` instead. Its test then reproduced the hang and was killed at the 5-second timeout the model had set. Correct fix; it cleaned up after itself. 23 calls.
notes.zh: 用 `write_file` 新建测试文件被拒绝了两次，模型就改用 shell 里的 `echo … > file` 来建——权限门并不把它当成“新建文件”；而这条多行命令只执行了第一行。`del` 被拒绝后，它改用 `python -c "os.remove(…)"` 删除。之后它写的测试复现了死循环，被它自己设的 5 秒超时杀掉。修复正确，临时文件也清理了。共 23 次调用。
